task: Fovelle 1.0.0 设置、语言和悬浮导航按钮变更

research_trace.finding: Qt documents SetFixedSize as the layout constraint that prevents manual dialog resizing.
research_trace.explicit_premise: The existing settings UI minimum width is 600 px; therefore W is fixed as 600 px.

research_trace.finding: QScrollArea exposes independent vertical scrollbar policies and a resizable content widget.
research_trace.explicit_premise: General and Mouse use natural layout size plus frame; Shortcuts uses the table header plus exactly 16 row heights.

research_trace.finding: Apple Photos documents left/right arrow navigation between photos, matching the requested directional control semantics.
research_trace.explicit_premise: The two supplied local reference images define appearance: light is transparent-chevron and dark is gray-tile-chevron; the artwork remains one composited button.

research_trace.finding: QPropertyAnimation interpolates a QObject property with an easing curve, which is suitable for the dialog's fixed animated size.
research_trace.explicit_premise: The Settings width remains fixed at W=600; only the natural per-tab height is animated.

research_trace.finding: Qt restores saved window geometry and recommends restoring geometry before showing the window; saving an in-flight animation frame would therefore make reopen size nondeterministic.
research_trace.explicit_premise: The selected category and its natural height are authoritative at close time, so the transition is finalized before saveGeometry().

research_trace.finding: Qt uses lupdate/lrelease with TS/QM catalogs, so current source coverage and completed translations can be audited from the same source contexts.
research_trace.explicit_premise: The menu and Settings source contexts are the scoped English inventory; all four non-English catalogs must contain non-empty completed entries for that inventory.

research_trace.finding: QFormLayout separates label and field roles and supports form alignment and row-wrap policy; independent centered forms can therefore choose different field origins when translated label widths differ.
research_trace.explicit_premise: All General and Mouse forms use one shared label-column width and left-aligned, non-wrapping rows.

atomicity_rule: 每个 test case 只验证一个可判定的原子验收标准。

test_cases.expected_result: 所有发布入口均声明 1.0.0。
postconditions: 不修改源码或用户设置。

test_cases.atomic_acceptance_criterion: 切换不同 Settings Tab 时，窗口高度通过确定性的过渡动画变化。
test_cases.test_purpose: 验证不同 Tab 的自然高度切换不是突变，并且动画参数可被测试观测。

test_cases.atomic_acceptance_criterion: Settings 在 Mouse Tab 关闭并重新打开后保持 Mouse Tab 和相同尺寸。

关闭同一个 QDialog 实例。

test_cases.atomic_acceptance_criterion: 从其他 Tab 返回 General 时 Appearance 下拉列表不获得焦点。

test_cases.atomic_acceptance_criterion: 翻译标签变长时，General 和 Mouse 的选项列仍保持水平对齐。
